sections.heading: Pattern: Intent-First APIs
sections.body: Start from user intent and design APIs that make the common path obvious and ergonomic.

sections.heading: Pattern: Local-First Notes
sections.body: Keep user notes and highlights responsive and resilient by defaulting to local-first persistence.

sections.heading: Pattern: Progressive Rendering
sections.body: Render meaningful content early and refine progressively to keep interactions fluid on all devices.
